build.note: In-game capture of 16 October (recorded 15 October evening); M433 recoil operands as in current data/weapons.json (factor 72, time exponent 1.2).

question: Does the x0.8 recovery scale hold on the 72 / 1.2 profile (M433, fifteen weapons), do its 10 and 15-round bursts sit on the law when measured at 1x, and what does the spread indicator do in semi-auto pairs and automatic bursts?

capture.loadout: factory barrel, FMJ, standard magazine, ST Prism 5.00x, Standard then Lightened Suppressor, Bipod in the bottom slot (not deployed)
capture.loadoutNote: The Bipod was equipped so the left hand would not cover the lower left of the scope; it was never deployed (standing ADS throughout, loadout card at the start of every clip). The site treats an undeployed bipod as having no effect (data/attachments.json GRIPS bipod: noEffect true, every tier mod 0) and the game bipod recoil modifiers GRM_BipodDeployed_* are gated on the deployed flag (L4038); the predictions apply no modifier. The brief predictions (predict-m433-next.json) and predict-m433-meas.json agree at every shared gap.
capture.conditions: standing ADS, FOV 103, 27 m, 120 fps, 10 Mbps; spread indicator on for the first time

sourceFacts.method: Pipeline of L4043 with: the reticle centre from the ST Prism's pink-red centre dot; the green spread indicator masked in the mark, blurred-maxima and template-fit detectors (it reaches gray 165 and 170 px per parenthesis, so it would have counted as a mark); thin dark reticle lines inpainted before the template fit; an M433-specific mark template (median of 13 isolated upper marks) after the generic template split single marks at the 300 ms bands (null test 4 of 10). Burst extents measured directly on the 1x screenshots (L4046 method); the close-up is not used. Lens scale from the 1x cluster spacings. See ANALYSIS.md.

control.description: Lens magnification 5.036 over 1x (89.50 px/deg, IQR 0.136, n 57), against 4.975 for the TR-7 set; null test with the M433 template 0 of 15 and 3 of 13 on the 200 ms bands, 2 of 10 on the 267 ms bands, 3 to 4 of 10 on the 300 ms bands; 1x detector finds the nominal mark count within one in most sprays.

points: Pairs (M433 template, degrees): Standard 0.279 +- 0.037 at 200 ms (stored 0.224, x0.9 0.253, x0.8 0.284), 0.101 +- 0.017 at 267 ms (stored 0.062, x0.8 0.115), 0.056 at 333 ms (estimator floor; stored -0.001, x0.8 0.013); Lightened 0.246 +- 0.063 at 200 ms (stored 0.178, x0.8 0.238; 6 of 15 resolved), 0.101 +- 0.020 at 267 ms (stored 0.027, x0.8 0.072), 0.134 at 350 ms (not established: null test 4 of 10).

Bursts at 1x (Standard / Lightened, degrees): 5 rounds 2.55 / 2.29 (stored 2.13 / 2.06, x0.8 2.23 / 2.17); 10 rounds 4.05 / 3.85 (3.98 / 3.74, 4.31 / 4.08); 15 rounds 5.66 / 4.71 (5.15 / 4.73, 5.72 / 5.31). No 20 or 25-round bursts were recorded.

Spread indicator: in the 13 semi-auto pairs it is never drawn before, during or within 0.3 s after a pair (0 of 780 frames) and appears only while the operator side-steps; in the automatic bursts it appears on the first shot at 63 px (0.70 deg outer width) and opens on every shot to 221 px (2.47 deg) by shot 10, pulsing within each interval, then closes over 0.2 s after the last shot.
All-weapons fit with the M433 added (38 pair bands, 18 burst extents): stored law 1099.5, applied x0.8 359.2, best twoPool S=0.1 F2=2 C=0.8 offset=0.06 241.8.

inference: On the 72 / 1.2 profile the 200 ms Standard band sits on the x0.8 law and the 267 ms bands between x0.8 and x0.9 on both suppressors; the Standard 15-round extent sits on x0.8 and the Lightened on the stored law, so the profile gives 0.8 to 1.0 with the bursts the less certain part (sd 0.1 to 0.2). Nothing on this weapon repeats the TR-7 and AK-205 tail: the 333 ms Standard band is at the floor where the x0.8 law gives 0.00 and the stored law 0.00. The indicator frames show that semi-auto pairs at 200 ms draw no spread indicator while automatic fire opens it from the first shot.
unresolved: The 350 ms Lightened band (template fit not trustworthy on this mark shape at the floor); the indicator's units; 20 and 25-round bursts on this profile (not recorded).
siteImpact: None applied; the x0.8 scale stands and is consistent with the M433 pairs and the Standard bursts; the Lightened bursts sit nearer the stored law.

leads.title: M433 pairs and bursts (72 / 1.2 profile): 200 ms band on the x0.8 law, 267 ms between x0.8 and x0.9, no tail at 333 ms; 15-round extents 5.66 / 4.71 deg against 5.72 / 5.31 at x0.8; the spread indicator never appears in semi-auto pairs and opens from the first automatic shot
leads.summary: Standard pairs 0.279 / 0.101 / 0.056 deg at 200 / 267 / 333 ms against 0.284 / 0.115 / 0.013 at x0.8; Lightened 0.246 / 0.101 at 200 / 267 ms against 0.238 / 0.072. Bursts at 1x: 5 / 10 / 15 rounds 2.55 / 4.05 / 5.66 Standard and 2.29 / 3.85 / 4.71 Lightened. All-weapons fit: stored 1099.5, applied x0.8 359.2, best 241.8.
leads.reopenWhen: 20 and 25-round bursts on this profile measured at 1x, or a readable implementation of the recovery law.
